# Set Items Crafting

by MaxrollLast Updated: April 2, 2026

### Advertisement

This website is supported by ads.

Sets are a group of items that, when worn together, provide additional bonuses beyond what an individual Set Item offers. Normally, the only way to receive these bonuses is by wearing the appropriate Set Items. The Woven Faction has since changed this by allowing Set Items to be Shattered into Shards that can then be crafted onto other items. In this guide, we discuss how Set Items work and how you can Shatter them to use in other items.

## Set Items Explained

Set Items Crafting

Set Items are similar to Uniques in that they are specific items that drop in the world with their own identifiable name and properties. However, they differ from Uniques in a very important way; each Set Item is part of a larger set of 2-3 items that, when worn together, provides specific bonuses that would otherwise be inaccessible.

This means they are much more powerful when worn together, but it also creates a significant downside. In order to fully benefit from these items, two or three gear slots must be reserved, and since Sets cannot become Legendaries they provide no stat flexibility. This is where Set Item crafting comes in.

Two Set Items that, when worn together, provide a specific Set bonus.

## Crafting Set Items

Set Items Crafting

You can use Set Item Shards to craft your own Set Items. To do so, you need to shatter a copy of the Set Item you want to turn into a shard in The Great Bridge Woven Echo. At the end of it, there is a crafting station where you can place Set Items to shatter them and obtain Set Item Shards, which can then be crafted onto any item that can use Shards. However, this crafting is restricted to items that are of the same type as the original Set item. For example, a Set Item Shard from Blade of the Forgotten Knight can only be placed on One-Handed Swords.

Set Item Shards, like Blade of the Forgotten Knight Reforged, provide you with some of the affixes on the original Set Item as well as the Set Bonus you get from wearing multiple of that Set.

Set Item affixes cannot be used to make Legendaries, so don't use them on an Item you plan on combining with a Unique that has Legendary Potential.

The Forge of Shattering with The Forgotten Knight Set items ready to be Shattered.

Learn more about Woven Echoes with our Woven Faction Guide.

## Farming Set Items

Set Items Crafting
Crafting with Set Affixes can create very powerful items, but to do so you need enough Set Items to Shatter. Here are some tips to help you speed up your farming.

- Merchant's Guild members can buy Set Items from the Bazaar as early as rank 2.
- For Circle of Fortune, rank 4 will cause any Set Item to drop as the full Set. CoF can also purchase Prophecies that target the specific item type for that Set Item.
- Some Set Items only drop from specific bosses, like Shard of the Shattered Lance and Fragments of the Shattered Lance.
- Echo rewards can be Set Items. This is inefficient compared to buying them from the Bazaar or running Prophecies, but can be a good supplemental source if you run across them in your Timelines.
- Rune of Ascendance can create Set Items. Since you choose the item type that is ascended, this can be a reasonably efficient option if you have a lot of Runes and no other use for them. Note that the pool of possible outcomes includes Uniques and CoF rank 4 does not apply, so this strategy is objectively worse than using the Bazaar or Prophecies.

Learn more about Set Item Farming with our Unique and Set Item Farming Guide.

## Summary

Set Items Crafting
- Set Items are similar to Uniques, but provide additional bonuses when worn together.
- The affixes on Set Items can limit their utility, but Shattering them into Set Affix Shards solves this by letting you use them in crafting.
- Set Affixes provide some of the affixes from the original item, plus the Set bonus.
- Set Affixes can only be crafted on items that are the same type as the original Set Item that was shattered to make it.
- There are many strategies for farming Set Items, but taking advantage of the Item Factions is the most efficient.
